name: nin-claude-dashboard
description: See your Claude Code sessions and requirement status per project, inside VS Code.

commands.title: Claude Dashboard: Select Google Key File

claudeDashboard.keyPath.description: Path to the Google service account key (.json) used to read each project's Sheet. Leave empty to skip Sheets (MAP.md still works).

claudeDashboard.port.description: Local port for the dashboard server. 0 picks a free port.

claudeDashboard.editorCommand.description: Command used by the "Open in VS Code" button. Empty uses `code`.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Claude Dashboard
walkthroughs.description: Open the dashboard and optionally connect Google Sheets.

steps.title: Open the dashboard
steps.description:
See your projects and sessions.
[Open Dashboard](command:claudeDashboard.open)

steps.title: Connect Google Sheets (optional)
steps.description:
Pick your service account key file.
[Select Google Key File](command:claudeDashboard.selectKey)
